evidence.description: Sila announced the acquisition of Norfolk Air; exact closing date not stated.
Sila announced the acquisition of Guy Smith; exact closing date not stated.
Goldman Sachs Alternatives announced it would acquire a majority stake, subject to customary regulatory approvals; close date not stated.
Current Sila company site identifies Sila as a portfolio company of Private Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives.
Sila's brand page states Norfolk Air became part of Guy Smith Home Services in 2025; exact date not stated.
Stonebridge states Paramount successfully completed the acquisition on May 1, 2025.

Stonebridge announced the recapitalization closed on March 11, 2021; the release says founder retained significant ownership and equity capital also came from Midwest, 747 Capital, management, and Stonebridge.
Stonebridge's current portfolio companies page continues to list Paramount Mechanical.
